Family advocate who brought Adnan's case to Koenig.

How Rabia Chaudry connects

  • Work: Serial Season 1 — Rabia Chaudry brought Adnan's case to Koenig and opened Season 1.
  • Work: Undisclosed — Rabia Chaudry launched Undisclosed after Serial.

What is Rabia Chaudry?

Rabia Chaudry is the lawyer and family friend who asked Sarah Koenig to look at Adnan Syed's conviction, opening Season 1, and later hosted the Undisclosed podcast.

Key threads lead to Serial Season 1 and Undisclosed.
